'''0.21c''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that attempted to make the matchmaking system more strict and increased the recoil of the [[AKS-74U]].

==Changelog==
===Black Market===
* [[AKS-74U]] recoil increased

===Gameplay===
* Connection to consecutive battle bug fixed
* Match-making rules enforced. Matching time may increase, especially for the players in high-profile outfit. This will reduce the number of cases when new players get to fight against fully-armed opponents

===User interface===
* Incorrect display of ammo packs in the gear window fixed;
* Players list sorting bug fixed
